name: Having Children
overview: Scripture reveals that having children is a divine blessing and command, as God instructs humanity to be fruitful and multiply, filling the earth (Genesis 1:28; 9:1). Children are portrayed as a heritage and reward from the Lord, emphasizing their sacred value (Psalms 127:3). Additionally, God brings joy and purpose to those who are barren, enabling them to become joyful mothers (Psalms 113:9), highlighting His sovereign role in the gift of children.
